lead: A mid-goal edit to `docs/agent/goals/<n>-<slug>.md` is invisible to the loop until the same edit lands in `docs/agent/loop-goal.md`.
body: That file is `goal-switch.py`'s verbatim copy of the goal's prose and the one `orient.py` pipes into a session, and nothing re-syncs the two between switches — so a settled standing decision can sit in the source while every pack still prints the question. Edit both, and `diff` them before committing.
